honest_finding: Prior to Phase F, RIWI consisted of (1) a production-grade FastAPI Gateway, RBAC, Provider Router, Tool Broker, Knowledge Store, Learning/Security Signal governance layer, and 105 contract schemas, plus (2) a purely static, uncalibrated regex/surface-heuristic fallback in step31_riwi_evaluators.py and step32_writing_riwi.py. It did NOT contain a trained/calibrated local statistical or neural language evaluation model, prompt-relevance semantic scorer, General Training Task 1 letter evaluator, or local WAV/PCM acoustic fluency analyzer.

gateway_and_routing.capabilities: 31 HTTP endpoints, RBAC, bounded concurrency (Semaphore(4)), in-flight request deduplication, SSRF/outbound guard, 6 domain tools.

knowledge_and_governance.capabilities: PostgreSQL FTS knowledge retrieval, conflict detection, candidate->approved->active lifecycle, 105 contract definitions, AES-256-GCM portability Modes A/B/C.

identified_limitations: Ignores the prompt text when scoring Task Achievement / Task Response (cannot detect off-topic essays or copied prompts).
Uses hardcoded 6.0 starting scores and uncalibrated fixed step adjustments.
Does not distinguish Academic Task 1 (data/process/map) from General Training Task 1 (formal/semi-formal/informal letters).
Only checks 28 surface regex patterns from step31_riwi_text.py.
Confidence formula depends only on word count and sentence count, never flagging off-topic or gibberish text.

existing_local_speaking_evaluator.function: sval(transcript, part, durationMs, promptText, origin, pronunciationAvailable)
identified_limitations: Operates on transcript text + durationMs only; has no local WAV/PCM acoustic signal analyzer for pause count, silence ratio, or articulation rate.
Does not evaluate semantic relevance of the transcript to promptText.
Correctly leaves pronunciation band as None (limited=True), which must be preserved whenever phoneme-level audio evidence is absent.
Works well for objective structure matching and target-word inflection checks, but covers only 28 grammar/preposition/tense error patterns.
